parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true — iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession in Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift and EntityResolverMockWebSession in Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is a test fixture warrants no-action; here both are. Extracting these into a shared generic session mock would couple two unrelated test packages (Artwork and Metadata) and risk making test infrastructure a production dependency. The single differing slot — responses:[Data] vs responses:[String: Data] — reflects genuinely different protocol shapes required by each test suite, further undermining the case for a shared generic.
